intro.text: A faith of old Scadrial, spread across many lands, which held that there is one God and that making art is the only true way to worship.

description.text: Artists ranked above priests. Followers loved colour and shade, and prized poetry that described them.

items.text: As Luthadel prepares for battle, Sazed suggests the faith to Clubs, since his woodworking is a kind of art, and gives him its symbol: a plain wooden disk carved with a brush.
When Sazed remakes the world, he uses Dadradah poems as a guide to restore its plants, sky and landscape.
